about.title: An artist all my life
about.quote: Every work I make is a part of me.
story: Ever since I was a child, from my very first school projects, I have been fascinated by the world of art. Painting, sculpture and every form of visual expression became my language, a passion that grew up with me and has never left me.

Every work holds my thoughts, my emotions and the way I see the world. With every brushstroke and every sculpted detail I try to pass on something unique and deep, something that can touch the soul of whoever is looking.

My works mirror what I have lived, a window opened onto my inner self and onto the way I perceive the world. Every creation, a painting or a sculpture, is an extension of myself, a piece of my soul taking shape and colour.
I love trying out different techniques and styles, always looking to grow and to express my emotions honestly.
